title: round-level.v1
description: A round level in the game (spec 006 FR-020). Rows are the reference engine's input: bottom first, '.' open, '#' wall, a material code otherwise; the frame ring and wall are part of the rows. A bridge choice's anchor is an orthogonal neighbour of its cell (17 §8, 2026-10-28). board.overlay, when present, is the generator's wall laid over the approved picture, in picture coordinates ([x, y], x from the left, y from the top): the rows are that picture with each wall cell '#', each site a bridge site, and the ring closed outward of every strip cell on the picture's edge. board.recolor, when present, paints picture cells another material before the overlay is laid.

shown.description: presentation only (17 §8, the owner, 2026-10-31): the site is not drawn until its approach opens; absent means shown over the cubes from the start

hiddenCells.description: hidden cells (rules 17 §8 «Скрытые клетки», the owner, 2026-11-01): indices y*w+x of rowsBottomFirst (row 0 at the bottom), sorted ascending, each a material cell; shown as a neutral «?» cube until it gets an open neighbour reachable from an entry (or is an entry cell), then an ordinary cell; never with hidden pods

spring.description: the spring: an index y*w+x of rowsBottomFirst (row 0 at the bottom) of an empty '.' cell, not an entry or a latch key

cell.description: the exit: an empty '.' cell of its own, not an entry, the spring or a latch key (an enclosed pocket inside the picture or an edge)

route.description: the channel's cells from the spring to this exit (both included), each an orthogonal neighbour of the one before, no repeat; drawn over the cubes (presentation), the cells under it stay ordinary work

rideUs.description: a walker's ride along the channel in µs (whole milliseconds), added once on its way out and once on its way back when its route starts at this chosen exit

channel.description: the Drop water channel (rules 17 §8 «Drop Водный канал», the owner, 2026-11-05; spec 006 FR-069; tools/rounds/README.md «Channel»): ready (event channelReady) at the first moment the spring is reached by an open path from an active entry; then the player chooses an exit (command channel, free, no place); the chosen exit becomes an additional active entry (event channelOpen), the other never does; absent means none

cells.description: the covered cells: indices y*w+x of rowsBottomFirst, sorted ascending, a full rectangle of material cells (never an entry or a hidden cell, never under another shutter)

count.description: how many units of that material must be done (cleared anywhere since the start) before it opens

shutters.description: the Twig wooden shutters (rules 17 §8 «Twig Деревянные створки», the owner, 2026-11-05; spec 006 FR-070; tools/rounds/README.md «Shutters»): while closed the covered cells are no targets and no passage; the count falls with every unit of its material done anywhere; at 0 it opens (event shutterOpen) and its cells are ordinary work; index i is the shutter of the event; absent means none

recolor.description: the level's recolouring of its approved picture (rules 17 §3 and §6 «Акценты», the owner, 2026-11-01): [x, y, code] in picture coordinates (x from the left, y from the top), each a material cell of the picture that this level paints another material (never an empty cell or a strip, never its own colour, one entry per cell); applied before board.overlay and never under its walls; absent means none

water.description: the water ring round a water channel's island (rules 17 §8 «Остров за водой», the owner, 2026-11-07): picture cells that become '#' like walls (closed outward on the picture's edge alike) but are drawn as the stream in cream stone banks, never as stone; absent means none

column.description: the tray column the latch stands in

depth.description: how many pods of that column stand before the latch (at least one pod stands behind it)

key.description: the acorn key's cell: an index y*w+x of board.rowsBottomFirst (row 0 at the bottom) of an empty '.' cell, not an entry

latches.description: latch + acorn key (rules 17 §8 «Засов и жёлудь-ключ», the owner, 2026-11-01; tools/rounds/README.md «Latch and key»): a latch is an element of its column's queue, not a pod (no quota, no place); it blocks the pods behind it until it is the column's top and its key cell is reached by an open path from an entry, then it opens by itself (event latchOpen); index i of this array is the latch of the event; absent means none
